name: 29621-cachedimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine process.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.29B params (~16 GB); native-resolution vision tower; remaining shapes in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 16, warmup 25%, no cooldown, bounded at 600 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, static seed 29621.
workload: single-turn image chat: one fixed 2048x2048 JPEG and a fixed six-word instruction, byte-identical on every request, 16 output tokens (`ignore_eos`); rows from `configs/fixed-image.jsonl`.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant for a single repeated high-resolution photo, serving 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. vLLM 0.11.2.dev, commit 68ffbca7e462cfa6a32b46dabc9a604c7c1b918d.
# The load is not in this file -- it is scenario.json's `streams`.
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 32
# Must match the one image per request the workload sends: it is both the admission limit and
# what the engine's startup profiling pass is sized against.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
mm-processor-cache-gb: 4
mm-processor-cache-type: lru
enable-prefix-caching: true
